metadata.title: Dashboard Initial Load and Basic Status Update

story.iWant: to see my study activities on a dashboard and update their status
story.soThat: I can easily track my daily progress

tasks.task: Implement initial Dashboard component for displaying study activities. (AC: #1) Fetch `study_sessions` for the current user from Supabase. Render `StudyTaskCard` components for each session.
Develop the `StudyTaskCard` component to display individual study activities. (AC: #1) Implement visual states for 'Not Started', 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Missed'.

Implement functionality to update study activity status via `StudyTaskCard`. (AC: #2) Implement click handler for status cycling (`Not Started` -> `In Progress` -> `Completed`). Implement "x" icon for marking as 'Missed' (on hover).
Integrate `DashboardManager.updateSessionStatus` to persist status changes to Supabase. (AC: #3) Ensure status updates are transactional and durable.
Add unit tests for `StudyTaskCard` component states and interactions.
Add integration tests for dashboard loading and status update persistence.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The dashboard successfully loads and displays a calendar view of the user's study activities. tech-spec-epic-4.md#AC1

A user can update the status of a study activity (e.g., 'Not Started', 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Missed') by interacting with the `StudyTaskCard` component. tech-spec-epic-4.md#AC4 ux-design-specification.md#Component:StudyTaskCard
Changes to a study activity's status are saved automatically and are persistent across sessions. tech-spec-epic-4.md#AC5

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Dashboard & Progress Tracking
doc.snippet: This document provides the technical specification for Epic 4: Dashboard & Progress Tracking. This epic covers the primary user interface for daily interaction with the study planner. It's where users will visualize their generated schedule, track their progress, and update the status of their study tasks. The goal is to create a dashboard that is clear, motivating, and makes the daily check-in loop fast and satisfying. The implementation is primarily frontend-focused, leveraging Supabase's real-time capabilities to keep the view in sync.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Dashboard & Progress Tracking
doc.snippet: A main dashboard view featuring a calendar of study activities. Progress bars for each course, giving a visual overview of completion. The ability to click on a daily activity to view its details. Functionality to update the status of a study activity (e.g., 'Not Started', 'Completed', 'Missed'). Automatic and persistent saving of progress updates.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Dashboard & Progress Tracking
doc.snippet: This epic realizes the 'daily-use loop' described in the architecture and relies heavily on the frontend and its direct integration with Supabase. The Next.js Frontend will fetch all study_sessions for the user directly from the Supabase Database and render them in the UI. When a user updates a task's status, the frontend will send an UPDATE query directly to Supabase.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Dashboard & Progress Tracking
doc.snippet: This epic reads from the courses and study_sessions tables. The key interaction is updating the status field of the study_sessions table. All interactions are via the `supabase-js` client.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Dashboard & Progress Tracking
doc.snippet: AC1: The dashboard displays a calendar view of the user's study activities. AC4: A user can update the status of a study activity ('Not Started', 'Completed', 'Missed'). AC5: Progress updates are saved automatically and are persistent across sessions.

doc.title: AI-Powered Personal Study Planner - Solution Architecture
doc.snippet: The Next.js Frontend is the client-side application running in the user's browser. It renders the UI, manages client state, handles user interactions, communicates with backend services. Supabase (Postgres) is the primary data store. Supabase Auth is the authentication service.

doc.title: AI-Powered Personal Study Planner - Solution Architecture
doc.snippet: The data model is designed to be simple, relational, and secure, with Row Level Security (RLS) enabled on all tables to ensure data privacy. CREATE TABLE public.study_sessions (... status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Not Started' CHECK (status IN ('Not Started', 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Missed')), ...); CREATE POLICY 'Enable all access for own sessions' ON public.study_sessions FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

doc.title: ibe160 UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: The most frequent and central user action is the daily check-in. The user will view their dashboard, identify the day's tasks, and update their status (e.g., `Completed`, `Missed`). This interaction must be exceptionally fast, simple, and satisfying to encourage daily engagement.

doc.title: ibe160 UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Purpose: To display a single study task for the day and provide a fast, satisfying, and low-effort way for the user to update its status. Primary Interaction (Clicking the Card): A single click on the card will cycle the status from `Not Started` -> `In Progress` -> `Completed`. Secondary Interaction (Marking as Missed): To prevent accidental negative marking, marking a task as `Missed` will require a more deliberate action, such as clicking a small 'x' icon that appears only on hover.

constraints.constraint: Next.js Frontend will directly interact with Supabase for `study_sessions` data (fetch and update).
Row Level Security (RLS) on `study_sessions` table ensures data isolation per user.
The `status` field in `study_sessions` table uses an enum `('Not Started', 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Missed')`.
Client-side state management for dashboard will use Zustand.
`@supabase/supabase-js` will be used for all Supabase interactions.
New components will follow existing component structure in `src/components/`.
New services will follow existing service structure in `src/services/`.
State management will integrate with the existing Zustand store.
